construct: CHILD ORDER that varies on one enum axis by a ROTATION (A,B,C -> B,C,A) — a permutation that is neither the identity nor a reversal
why: The only per-variant child-order spelling either target system has is a reversed main axis (CSS row-reverse / Figma children.reverse()); an arbitrary permutation has no contract spelling and no canvas lowering. It must be REFUSED BY NAME rather than flattened onto the base order — the honest refusal this class exists to protect, and the guard that keeps the reversal door from being widened into a guess.

canvas.note: no canvas spelling for an arbitrary per-variant child permutation
